product_name: PD1180-EPR — NEMA 34 Smart Motor-Mounted Stepper Controller with USB-C PD 3.1 EPR
requested_delivery: Fully populated, programmed and functionally tested PCBA for the confirmed motor/load

additional_services.shipment_acceptance: HOLD: approved images, programming fixture/method, first-article qualification and per-board powered results are pending
additional_services.instructions: Request programming and Function Test explicitly; service availability for this board and its 48 V motor/brake test must be accepted by the provider. No order has been placed.

pcb.via_in_pad_count_basis: 2026-10-27 source-rule ECO native board: finished-drill overlap with top paste lands; exact coordinates and board hash in engineering/top-side-placement.json power_eco_via_audit. Same 62 locations before/after this ECO; earlier 63-location inventory was stale. Includes 40 MOSFET drain-pad, four U34 thermal and four U16 ground-pad vias.

usb_impedance.copper_requirement: 1 oz outer AND inner; do not substitute a standard 0.5 oz inner stack-up

assembly.dnp: Do not substitute electrical values or package variants without engineering review
assembly.through_hole_and_tall_parts: Include all fitted BOM headers and bulk capacitors in the agreed assembly scope; selective/hand assembly method requires provider confirmation
assembly.optional_unpopulated_policy: Bottom footprints only; omit from fitted BOM/CPL and paste. No magnet interface is qualified on the ordered single-shaft motor.
assembly.external_motor_harness: Separate VHR-4N / SVH-41T-P1.1 / 16 AWG cable assembly; see motor-harness.md. Not included automatically in PCB assembly.

U3_eeprom.requirement: Program approved TI TPS26750 full-flash image and verify/read back after assembly
U3_eeprom.interface: EEP_SDA/EEP_SCL on TPS26750 I2Cc; separate from STM32 PD_SDA/PD_SCL. Fixture access, power and bus ownership require qualification.

U16_mcu.requirement: Program qualified motor-enabled firmware over SWD and verify/read back
U16_mcu.commissioning_only: pd1180-commissioning-firmware.zip contains a diagnostics image with motor operation locked; it does not meet ready-to-run delivery acceptance

functional_test.required_record: Board serial/revision, both image hashes, programming verification, qualified motor/load/settings, measured rails/PD/current/temperature/brake response, inhibit tests, operator/date and PASS/FAIL
functional_test.shipment_rule: Programming verification and the approved per-board powered motor/fault acceptance must pass for every serial number before shipment
